description: SECURITY (s441 round 4, review round 3 findings 1-2; reviewer-executed: a wrong password accepted). The fire-and-forget exemption requires the GLOBAL scheduler. Here the scheduler is replaced by a `const { setTimeout } = …` destructure between `"/*"` and `"*/"` strings — the round-3 text scan stripped it as a block comment, so passing an async-colored function to it hands back an unawaited Promise — always truthy. The exemption is now decided on the tree (any binding, key or write of the scheduler name anywhere in the file withdraws it), not on the text.
rationale: §13.2: the fire-and-forget exemption applies only to the global scheduler; when the file binds or writes the scheduler name, passing an async-colored function to it SHALL be E-ASYNC-FN-ESCAPES-AS-VALUE (§34).
